query: SELECT id, COALESCE(connection_id,linked_account_id) AS "connection_id!", channel_id, user_id, created_at, payload, provider_message_id, attempts FROM meta_messaging_send WHERE (linked_account_id IS NOT NULL)=$1 AND native_retry_at<=now() AND provider_message_id IS NOT NULL AND (linked_account_id IS NOT NULL OR message_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_message m WHERE m.message_id=meta_messaging_send.message_id AND m.media_state='pending')) AND state IN ('accepted','sent','delivered','read','failed') ORDER BY native_retry_at,id LIMIT 50
